text:
maria: quick proposal: introduce an 'upload_gate' that runs a tiny lint+microbench on model uploads. goal: fail fast on obvious export/runtime/quality issues and keep full bench for scheduled/backfill runs. thoughts?

alex: sounds useful. main risk = blocking loops for active devs. can we make it non-blocking by default? :+1:

maria: yeah — thinking async provisional publish (dev-only) for 72h TTL. gate results can auto-unpublish on fail.

jin: two things: (1) quick-lint: shape/batch checks + loader sanity, (2) microbench: small sample set to check token-stability and latency. keep probe <60s.
jin: example command: `probe-lite --model $ID --samples 30 --max-tokens 200 --budget 60s --seed 1234`

sajid: metrics proposal for microbench: p50/p95 token latency, tokens/sec, perplexity_ratio vs baseline, top1_stability (fraction identical top-1 across seeds). flag thresholds: perplexity_ratio>1.6 or top1_stability<0.82 -> flag.

kevin: add a batch-dim exporter lint: run forward with batch=1 and batch=2; compare output shapes and non-NaN. catches most export mistakes. also KV warmup check: run a few warm-prefix steps so we catch cache init regressions.
lina: ops/telemetry: tag runs with `upload_gate` and `probe_id`. store artifacts: `s3://probes/<model-id>/<probe-id>/probe-report.json` including runner image sha and kernel-set. keep p50/p95 and cost estimate.
maria: on flagged models, auto-create a 0.5% canary route for 24h (dev opt-in). enterprise customers can opt for fail-open manual-review checkbox.
alex: agree on fail-open option but require manual review within 48h. also add an expedited deep-bench request button for owners.

prober-bot: probe finished for model "kartal-7b-fp16" — status: FLAGGED. failed checks: exporter-batch-lint, golden-prompt-3 mismatch. report: https://internal.logs/probes/xyz789 :warning:

kevin: exporter-batch-lint log? usually batch dim error is a missing leading batch axis.

prober-bot: exporter-batch-lint: "inference forward crashed for batch=2: IndexError: too many indices for tensor".

sajid: yep classic. suggest we auto-run a quick re-export helper that prints shape metadata and a minimal reproducible .npy sample for debugging. devs can attach that to an issue.
jin: reproducibility note: probe must fix runtime env — snapshot runner image + quant params + kernel selection. run with `--seed` and record seed in probe-report.
lina: ops question: do we run deep-bench automatically on provisional models nightly, or only on demand? cost tradeoffs.
maria: nightly for provisional models that are not flagged. flagged ones need owner action to requeue. also allow owners to mark `skip-heavy-eval` for private dev models (opt-in). default = run.

alex: UX: show probe status on model page with artifacts link, quick summary (pass/flag), and one-click escalate to deep bench.

kevin: implementation: reuse prober lambda + runner images, small probe binary baked into upload service so it can run locally in the same network. write probe artifacts to S3 and emit telemetry event. PR incoming for batch-lint tomorrow.
sajid: i'll produce a candidate set of golden prompts per architecture (small-ish prompts that exercise reasoning/formatting). will share matrix with coverage tags.
maria: next steps: i'll write a short follow-up doc with flow diagram (upload -> probe-lite -> provisional publish -> nightly deep-bench -> full publish). @lina please sketch telemetry fields; @kevin add exporter-batch-lint to ingestion checklist; @sajid/@jin curate golden prompts. I'll circulate draft by EOD. :rocket:
